documents.url: https://democracy.manchester.gov.uk/documents/s65106/D3 P-1475 Domestic Abuse - Intersecting Needs Safe Accommodation.pdf

purpose: A contract for the provision of safe accommodation for victims and survivors of domestic violence and abuse, who have needs intersecting to their experience of domestic violence and abuse. The provision consists of twenty units of self-contained accommodation, with domestic violence and abuse recovery support.
raw_title: P-1475 Domestic Abuse - Intersecting Needs Safe Accommodation (2026/06/09A)
text:
The appointment of a provider to provide Domestic Abuse - Intersecting Needs Safe Accommodation in response to unmet need identified through the Council's Domestic Abuse Needs Assessment and Domestic Abuse Strategy, with particular attention to victims and survivors whose experience of domestic abuse is compounded by complex or intersecting support needs.

The award of this contract will provide specialist safe accommodation and support for victims and survivors with intersecting needs.
